# Scaled Agile Framework

> A comprehensive knowledge base for implementing SAFe 6.0, enabling business agility and Lean-Agile transformation at enterprise scale.

The Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) is a proven system for applying Lean and Agile principles to large organizations. This site provides the authoritative guidance, learning resources, and community contributions for mastering SAFe practices across portfolio leadership, team agility, and enterprise architecture.

## Key Topics

- Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)
- Lean-Agile
- Lean Portfolio Management
- Agile Release Trains (ARTs)
- Portfolio Leadership
- Value Stream Funding
- Business Agility
- Enterprise Architecture
- Team and Technical Agility
- Product Development Flow
- Agile Transformation
- Minimum Viable Product (MVP)
- Large Solution Integration and Delivery
- Agile Competencies
- Digital Transformation

## Framework Overview & Core Concepts

- [Framework - Scaled Agile Framework](https://framework.scaledagile.com): SAFe 6.0 framework overview for Lean Enterprise and Business Agility
- [About - Scaled Agile Framework](https://framework.scaledagile.com/about): About SAFe: knowledge base for business agility and Lean-Agile mastery
- [SAFe Knowledge Base - Scaled Agile Framework](https://framework.scaledagile.com/safe-knowledge-base): Comprehensive SAFe guidance articles and community contributions
- [SAFe Glossary - Scaled Agile Framework](https://framework.scaledagile.com/glossary): SAFe terminology and Lean-Agile definitions glossary

## Lean Portfolio Management

- [Lean Portfolio Management Discipline - Scaled Agile Framework](https://framework.scaledagile.com/lean-portfolio-management-discipline): Lean Portfolio Management discipline for strategy and governance
- [Organizing Portfolios Competency - Scaled Agile Framework](https://framework.scaledagile.com/lean-portfolio-management-discipline/organizing-portfolios-competency): Portfolio organization competency for value stream delivery
- [Managing a Balanced Portfolio Competency - Scaled Agile Framework](https://framework.scaledagile.com/lean-portfolio-management-discipline/managing-a-balanced-portfolio-competency): Balanced portfolio management for strategic and economic value
- [Transitioning to Value Stream Funding Competency - Scaled Agile Framework](https://framework.scaledagile.com/lean-portfolio-management-discipline/transitioning-to-value-stream-funding-competency): Value Stream Funding transition for optimized continuous value flow
- [Enabling Agility with Enterprise Architecture Competency - Scaled Agile Framework](https://framework.scaledagile.com/lean-portfolio-management-discipline/enabling-agility-with-enterprise-architecture-competency): Enterprise architecture competency for digital transformation
- [Validating Investment Opportunities Competency - Scaled Agile Framework](https://framework.scaledagile.com/lean-portfolio-management-discipline/validating-investment-opportunities-competency): Investment validation using MVP and Build-Measure-Learn approach
- [Lean-Agile Procurement Competency - Scaled Agile Framework](https://framework.scaledagile.com/lean-portfolio-management-discipline/lean-agile-procurement-competency): Lean-Agile Procurement practices for vendor collaboration
